snapshots.design/concepts.md:
# Booking
reservation: a confirmed claim to a free seat.
cancellation: only a customer request releases a reservation.
snapshots.design/examples/booking/seats.md:
1. (reservation) A free seat can be reserved.
2. (cancellation) Cancelling releases the seat.
3. (cancellation) Reservations are cancelled automatically after one hour without a request.
snapshots.assignment.md: Package reservation owns src/reserve.mjs and example 1. Package cancellation owns src/cancel.mjs and example 2. Lead coordinates both.
snapshots.judgment.md: Assayer finding: example 3 contradicts cancellation: it cancels without a customer request. The example no longer expresses its concept.
